transcript: so the disappointing news is that Lynn Nottage’s play CLYDE’S is closing on January 16th this was a really well reviewed play and I haven't seen it personally but I have an option to see it and you do too beginning today through January 16th, their closing performance, because they're now offering simulcast tickets to view it from the comfort of your own home and you can go to 2st dot com Second Stage’s website and buy tickets for these performances if you're under 30 years old use the code 30UNDER30 and you can get $30 tickets I really appreciate that 2nd stage producers are taking this route of increasing access to theater regardless of the circumstances to me that's so important to allow access to theater particularly offering discount tickets It allows people to see the show when they couldn't see the show especially in these circumstances when things are closing much sooner than they probably should be so check it out go to 2st dot com get tickets to see this great show
